label: build gui debug
command: cmake -G 'MinGW Makefiles' -S . -B build/cmake -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; cmake --build build/cmake; exit $LASTEXITCODE

label: build core debug
command: cmake -G 'MinGW Makefiles' -S . -B build/cmake -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; cmake --build build/cmake --target rust_core; exit $LASTEXITCODE
